program: E (the EMT 250 program on the 246), docs/EMT250_program.md §11-15
delays: integer device samples; positions after R's first direct tap

value.form: H(z) = (-g + z^-D) / (1 - g z^-D), in series, before the loops

value.feedback: negative: v[t] = u[t] - line[t - P], line = G{v}
value.read: after the loop filter (reads the line)

L.gain: as the direct path's L gain

value.law: the 246's own: tools/ml_lines.line_coefs(P, rt, lf, hf) / line_resp (shelf + HF pole, HF floor)

altiverb_family.note: LF from the 63-500 Hz decay (§16), HF from the 2-12.4 kHz decay (§17), held out

value.meaning: nine fixed reads on the loop lines, taken BEFORE the loop filter (v[t] = u[t] - line[t - P], line = G{v}; the static reads take line, after G; §17) (centre = output delay after R's direct tap, loop, signed R and L amplitudes, direct tap = 1), each read at centre + A x triangle(f_j t + phase_j), triangle in [-1, 1], phase independent per read and realisation, rate f_j = f x (1 +- fsd) per read; L reads the same address with its own amplitude, mdel samples later, or mdel + dl_same for the reads whose L and R signs agree (§16.7); integer addresses, no interpolation

plugin_faithful.note: §14.4-14.5: the UAD plugin's structure; fits E's statistics worse (250 vs 182), a listening alternative

moving_reads.label: S (reads, amplitudes, depth: E's low band, held out; speed spread: E's statistics) / H (triangle shape and rate: the UAD plugin)

value.note: L's output kernel; E has it, the LP lever does not cause it

capture_chain_tail.value: the Altiverb captures' chain has a slow tail (analysis/e250/kernel_tail.json, B-spline 540-4000 samples); a property of the capture chain, not of E: the plugin's own analogue chain replaces it
capture_chain_tail.label: S

value.note: the Altiverb family's steps; the 246's E table itself is unknown

LF_HF.value: the 246's LF x / HF x controls through the loop law
LF_HF.label: S

value.reference: the Altiverb family taken as AMPL 80

DELAY.value: a pure delay of the whole output, 0-999 ms, device samples; the Altiverb family at 0
DELAY.label: H

onset.value: at DELAY 0 E's R direct tap arrives with M's first cluster tap (Altiverb: S 10.17 / M 20.33 / L 40.42 / E 20.33 ms, one capture chain)
onset.label: S

level.value: E's direct tap 1 at the level of an S / M / L cluster tap at the same AMPL (the Altiverb normalised every preset to equal total energy, 64.3-64.6 dB, so the absolute program levels are not in the data)
level.label: H (calibration guess)

value.guess: 2nd-order Butterworth at the device rate below 12 kHz

capture_pretap.value: the Altiverb captures carry a deterministic, non-causal low-band component before the direct tap (deconvolution): e_model.pretap, for comparisons with captures only
capture_pretap.label: S

not_resolved: E's LFO rate within 0.5-0.65 Hz (E's own statistics; 0.553 = the 250's in seconds, adopted, or 0.608 = in samples) and the triangle shape (the UAD plugin; E cannot tell triangle from sine)

references.static_ir_note: render_ir(rt, moving=False, chain='device'), lf / hf the family's, AMPL 80, DELAY 0, LP open; device rate, (L, R)
references.targets_note: e_sim.stats of the eight RT >= 1.0 Altiverb presets (leave-one-out residuals); a plugin's E, rendered at those RTs through e_sim.capture's sweep method and the same function, should land within ~1.3-2 x the data's own half-vs-half cost (100)
